# Purpose

This package provides the glossary explorer Shiny app (`run_glossary()`), which
offers source-filtered lookup of IPBES and IPCC glossary terms with linked
in-definition term navigation.

The former side-by-side comparison app, together with its similarity scoring,
word-level diffs and directed term hierarchy graph, has been removed from this
branch.

# Data Sources and Artifacts

## Bundled package snapshots

- `inst/extdata/ipbes_glossary.csv`
- `inst/extdata/ipcc_glossary.csv`
- `inst/extdata/ipcc_report_names.csv` (report abbreviation to long name)
- `inst/extdata/merged_glossary_cache.rds`

## Runtime cache (user cache dir)

- `tools::R_user_dir("glossary.ipbes.ipcc", "cache")/ipcc_glossary.csv`
- `tools::R_user_dir("glossary.ipbes.ipcc", "cache")/startup_merged_cache.rds`

A cached `ipcc_glossary.csv` takes precedence over the bundled snapshot. While
one is present the bundled merged cache is bypassed and the app rebuilds on
launch.

# Scraping (IPCC)

`scrape_ipcc()` walks the `search.php` AJAX endpoint family:

1. `ajax.searchbyindex.php?q=<PREFIX>` -- collect term IDs from
   `span.alllink[data-phraseid]`.
2. `ajax.searchalloccurance.php?q=<PHRASE_ID>&r=` -- read the definition from
   `dd p` (fallback `dd`) and the reports from `data-report` attributes.
3. Write `id`, `prefix`, `term`, `definition`, `reports`, `downloaded_at`.

Requests are spaced by `Sys.sleep(0.3)` with a 15 s timeout.

Cross-reference (`See ...` / `See Also ...`) entries are not yet captured; see
`BACKGROUND.md` section 3.1.

# Loading and Cleaning

## IPBES

Concept names are lowercased so case variants group together, multi-assessment
entries are split into one row per assessment, and definitions pass through
`clean_html()`.

## IPCC

The cache file is preferred over the bundled snapshot, definitions are cleaned,
and the semicolon-separated report list is expanded into one row per report.

# Merge Strategy

A full outer merge over normalised keys:

1. exact match on `normalise_term()`
2. for unmatched IPBES concepts, retry after `strip_qualifier()`
   (`abundance (ecological)` -> `abundance`)
3. remaining rows are kept as IPBES-only or IPCC-only

# Rendering a Term

Definitions identical across several assessments or reports collapse into a
single card listing all sources. Glossary terms occurring inside a definition
become links: matching is case-insensitive but preserves the original casing,
is constrained to whole words, prefers the longest term, and never overlaps an
already-claimed span. Definition text is HTML-escaped.

The `See also` panel lists every glossary term found in the definitions shown.

# Startup and Caching

Load order: packaged merged cache, then user startup cache (if the source file
signatures match), then a full rebuild.

The rendered `definition_html` and `see_also_list` are pre-computed at build
time and stamped with `.HIGHLIGHT_CACHE_VERSION`. Bump that constant whenever
the rendered HTML or the see-also derivation changes, or a stale cache will be
treated as current.

# Running Locally

```r
glossary.ipbes.ipcc::run_glossary()
```

# Tests

```r
devtools::test()
```

The suite covers the data pipeline, term catalog and lookup, highlighting and
in-definition linking, hover previews, see-also derivation, both caches, and
the server logic end to end via `shiny::testServer()`.
